customSections.label: Why the JEFCOED Source Shows Two March E-Learning Dates
customSections.content: The updated calendar contains an internal conflict. Its March grid and main event list both mark Friday, March 6 as E-Learning, while the summary list at the bottom says Monday, March 9. This page uses March 6 because it appears in two places on the official source. Families should follow any later correction announced by JEFCOED.

calendarFaqs.q: When did Jefferson County Schools start in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: The first student day was Thursday, August 7, 2025. JEFCOED scheduled teacher workdays and professional-development days August 1 and August 4–6 before students began.

calendarFaqs.q: Are JEFCOED E-Learning days student holidays?
calendarFaqs.a: No. E-Learning dates are student learning days. The updated 2025–26 calendar identifies September 2, October 13, February 13, a March date, and May 1 as E-Learning days.

calendarFaqs.q: Was the March JEFCOED E-Learning day March 6 or March 9?
calendarFaqs.a: The official source conflicts with itself: its March grid and main event list show March 6, while the bottom summary says March 9. This page uses March 6 because it appears twice, but families should follow any later JEFCOED correction.

calendarFaqs.q: When did students return after JEFCOED Mid-Year Holidays?
calendarFaqs.a: Mid-Year Holidays ran through January 1, 2026. January 2 was professional development and January 5 was a teacher workday, so students returned Tuesday, January 6.

calendarFaqs.q: Were the JEFCOED weather dates guaranteed days off?
calendarFaqs.a: No. February 16 and March 23–24 were identified as weather days if needed. Their status depended on whether JEFCOED activated them for weather make-up.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can I verify the archived JEFCOED calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Use the updated official PDF linked in Calendar Downloads and Sources and Review Notes. The JEFCOED calendar documents page is also linked for later file changes.

sourceReviewDetailsTitle: How we reviewed the JEFCOED calendar
sourceReviewDetails: Checked every districtwide date on the one-page calendar, including student attendance dates, E-Learning days, staff days, school closures, grading-period endings, and conditional weather dates.
Recorded March 6 as the E-Learning date because it appears in both the monthly grid and the main March event list.
Kept the conflicting March 9 date visible in the source note because it appears in the bottom E-Learning summary and may otherwise confuse families comparing the same official PDF.
Marked February 16 and March 23–24 as conditional because the calendar says they are weather days only if needed.
sourceNextReviewText: We review this archived page again if JEFCOED replaces the 2025–26 file or confirms a correction to the March E-Learning date.
